Shirtboy

A repeatable format for distinctive product stories.

Shirtboy website concepts organize custom-product case studies into an editorial format that connects client context, imagery and inquiries.

ProjectShirtboy
Contribution / source recordConfirm design, content and implementation responsibilities.

Design approach

  • A consistent information block introduces the client and project before the detailed story.
  • Alternating images and text give different products a shared editorial rhythm.
  • Related work and inquiry paths connect each case study to further exploration.

Why this work matters

The strongest angle is a reusable content system that supports varied stories without rebuilding the page structure each time.

Reference notes

Original case-template artifacts and a matching public Atlantic Aviation case reviewed. Confirm design, content and implementation responsibilities; client manufacturing results are not website-design outcomes.
